name: file-upload
title: File Upload
description: Hand-ported light-DOM dropzone (role=button, click-to-browse + HTML5 drag-and-drop) with single/multiple files, MIME/extension accept, max-size, max-files, per-file progress bars, image thumbnails via FileReader, and per-file/field error states. Drag-over halo via .hbd-file-upload--drag-over; per-file is-uploading/is-complete/is-error states. Reuses the shared .hbd-field label/hint/error/footer chrome from input. Controlled-first (files + onFilesChange, defaultFiles uncontrolled fallback) with an imperative getFiles/setProgress/setFileError ref handle. hbd:files-added -> onChange, hbd:file-removed -> onRemove, hbd:rejected -> onRejected.
